नेमादित्य son of Śrīdhara, father of Trivikrama Bhaṭṭa
(Damayantīkathā). Oxf. 120^a.

नेमिदूत a Jain poem in imitation of the Meghadūta, the
last pāda of which ends every stanza. by Vikrama,
son of Sāṅgaṇa. Peters. 4, 27. Extr. 25.
